negatives.message: @pixi-react-provisional/react-19.3 supports React 19.3.x (tested: 19.3.0), but React 19.1.9 is installed. Install and use the adapter package that matches the installed React minor (for example @pixi-react-provisional/react-19.1). See https://baseten.github.io/pixi-react/errors/UNSUPPORTED_TUPLE/

@pixi-react-provisional/react-18.0 supports React 18.0.x (tested: 18.0.0), but React 18.3.1 is installed. Install and use the adapter package that matches the installed React minor (for example @pixi-react-provisional/react-18.3). See https://baseten.github.io/pixi-react/errors/UNSUPPORTED_TUPLE/

The Pixi 8 adapter does not support this installation: pixi.js 8.5.0 is excluded: its ParticleContainer.destroy fails (fixed by 8.5.2). See https://baseten.github.io/pixi-react/errors/UNSUPPORTED_TUPLE/

dataOnly.statement: Data only, not verified: these results are never verification, never enter verifiedRanges and never change a peer range.
dataOnly.description: Data-only probes (issue 17). Each probe installs the packed adapters beside a React or pixi.js the adapter does not declare, ignoring peers, and records what every cell command does. The adapters' environment checks are bypassed in the conformance run only (cell.json dataOnly.bypassEnvironmentCheck), so the suite shows what would happen past them. Results are data, never verification: nothing here enters verifiedRanges or changes a peer range.

groups.description: The Pixi 7 adapter on pixi.js releases outside its peer range: the highest patch of 7.0 and 7.1 (below the 7.2.0 floor), and the excluded 7.4.0 (7.4.1 was never published to npm). Pixi 7.2 and 7.3, and React 18.0 to 18.2, were data-only probes until they became matrix cells (React 18 per-minor packages, the Pixi 7 range widened to 7.2).
